mpProductInsert.Description: Inserting products from the ModPlus database as blocks with extended data
mpProductInsert.FullDescription: Creating AutoCAD blocks based on data from the database. Extended data is added to the blocks, which allows processing these blocks with other plugins and creating a specification based on them\nExtended data can also be added to ordinary AutoCAD entities\nImportant! Blocks must be inserted with this plugin or copy already inserted, otherwise (when inserted by normal means AutoCAD), extended data will not be added!

mpProductInsert.h39: The insertion options "By two points" and "In the form of polyline" are only available for linear products (products whose length is required). The insertion option will use if it is active and selected. When using either of the two options, you do not need to pre-specify the length of the product in the window. The "By two point" insert option is available when you select the "Side view" or "Top view" display option. The insertion option "In the form of polyline" is available when selecting the "Front view (section)" display option
